name: magrittr
resume: All 42 exports are done. Indexing is 1-based, and the pipes return the value Python can assign. There is no compiled code in the Python port.

functions.done: Pipes a value and evaluates each step immediately, so side effects run forward.

check.case: 1:10 %!>% sum, 10 %!>% fsub(3), 10 %!>% fsub(3, .); messages foo, bar, baz

proof.python:
import contextlib
import io
import json
import statistics
import time

from magrittr.pipe import DOT, eager


def fsub(a, b):
    return a - b


def one():
    return [
        eager(list(range(1, 11)), sum),
        eager(10, (fsub, (3,), {})),
        eager(10, (fsub, (3, DOT), {})),
    ]


def foo(value):
    print("foo")
    return value


def bar(value):
    print("bar")
    return value


def baz(value):
    print("baz")
    return value


sentence = "1:10 %!>% sum returns 55.\n"
path = "/home/ahmed/killr_projects/killr/packages/magrittr/docs/output/%!>%-python.txt"
with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
    handle.write(sentence)

value = one()
elapsed = []
for _ in range(20):
    started = time.perf_counter()
    one()
    elapsed.append((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000)

buffer = io.StringIO()
with contextlib.redirect_stdout(buffer):
    eager(None, foo, bar, baz)
messages = buffer.getvalue().splitlines()
print(json.dumps({"value": value, "messages": messages, "median_ms": statistics.median(elapsed)}))

functions.name: debug_fseq

check.case: second of three functions is marked

proof.r:
.libPaths(c(path.expand("~/R/library"), .libPaths()))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(magrittr))
cmd <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = FALSE)
file_arg <- sub("^--file=", "", cmd[grepl("^--file=", cmd)])
root <- dirname(dirname(normalizePath(file_arg)))
out_dir <- file.path(root, "docs", "output")
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

f <- . %>% sqrt %>% log %>% exp
one <- function() debug_fseq(f, 2)
invisible(one())

  isdebugged(functions(f)[[2]]) &&
    !isdebugged(functions(f)[[1]]) &&
    !isdebugged(functions(f)[[3]])
)
elapsed <- numeric(20)
for (i in seq_len(20)) {
  t0 <- as.numeric(Sys.time())
  one()
  elapsed[[i]] <- as.numeric(Sys.time()) - t0
}
cat(sprintf('{"value":%.17g,"median_ms":%.17g}\n', value, median(elapsed) * 1000))
writeLines("debug_fseq(fseq, 2) returns NULL.", file.path(out_dir, "debug_fseq-r.txt"))

.libPaths(c(path.expand("~/R/library"), .libPaths()))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(magrittr))
cmd <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = FALSE)
file_arg <- sub("^--file=", "", cmd[grepl("^--file=", cmd)])
root <- dirname(dirname(normalizePath(file_arg)))
out_dir <- file.path(root, "docs", "output")
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

f <- . %>% sqrt %>% log
debug_fseq(f, 1)
one <- function() undebug_fseq(f)
value <- one()
if (!is.null(value)) stop("expected NULL")
if (any(vapply(functions(f), isdebugged, logical(1)))) stop("still marked")
elapsed <- numeric(20)
for (i in seq_len(20)) {
  t0 <- as.numeric(Sys.time())
  one()
  elapsed[[i]] <- as.numeric(Sys.time()) - t0
}
cat(sprintf('{"value":null,"median_ms":%.17g}\n', median(elapsed) * 1000))
writeLines("undebug_fseq(fseq) returns NULL.", file.path(out_dir, "undebug_fseq-r.txt"))

from magrittr._fseq import FSeq
from magrittr.fseq import _is_debugged, debug_fseq, undebug_fseq

def first(value):

def second(value):

fseq = FSeq([first, second])
